english_draft: Meta announced Q4 2025 results on January 28, 2026. The quarter ended December 31, 2025. Quarterly revenue was USD 59.893 billion. Revenue increased 24 percent year over year. Operating income was USD 24.745 billion. Operating margin was 41 percent. Diluted EPS was USD 8.88. Family daily active people averaged 3.58 billion in December 2025. This was 7 percent higher than one year earlier. Operating cash flow was USD 36.21 billion. Capital expenditure, including finance leases, was USD 22.14 billion. Free cash flow was USD 14.08 billion. The company provided Q1 2026 revenue guidance of USD 53.5 billion to USD 56.5 billion. This guidance is a forecast. The provided sources do not include consensus estimates. This report cannot compare guidance with consensus. The sources do not provide segment or expense details. This report cannot identify the exact product and cost drivers. Capital expenditure consumed about 61 percent of operating cash flow. This was the main reason free cash flow was lower than operating cash flow. There was no same-period Preview. The report cannot review a previous forecast.
